rationale: Motor vehicle collision with severe structural damage and bodily injury to the policyholder directly arising from the impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; vehicle is totaled with severe trunk damage. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Third-party insurance information documented on police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle going ~35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: Tree damage to a parked vehicle owned by the policyholder is a comprehensive auto claim, clearly covered under auto policies and distinct from property damage to the home.
claim_summary: Riley Kim's maple tree fell in windstorm and struck their parked vehicle in the driveway, causing significant damage to the hood and windshield. This is a comprehensive auto claim with an estimated cost in the $2,000–$8,000 range, subject to a $1,000 deductible.

case_facts.description: Maple tree fell in wind and landed on parked car
case_facts.damage_type: Hood and windshield smashed on vehicle
